# `ontology.concept.semantics.axis_kinds`

[ontology](../../README.md) · [concept](../README.md) · [semantics](README.md) · axis_kinds

v0.6: map each aggregation axis (the same axis names used in `additivity`) to its mac.concept.axis term. This lets the universal (measure_type x axis) additivity law in mac_vocabulary.yaml resolve for this concept's concrete axes — additivity becomes referenced data, not restated prose. Values are `mac.concept.concept.axis.*` references.

## Keys

You choose the names at this level — a column name, an axis name. `<name>` below stands for any one of them.

- [`<name>`](#name) — *string*

### `<name>`

*string* · optional

What kind of aggregation axis one column is, keyed by column name. DO NOT USE IT: the keys are column names while the planner looks them up by a lowercased CONCEPT name, so across 37 concepts and 47 entries not one key can ever match and the whole declaration is inert. Declare `axis` on the column instead. It remains readable so a bundle that still carries it is not broken by its absence.
